description:
Paperlane is a free iPhone app that turns your phone into a document scanner and produces a clean, multi-page PDF in seconds. It automatically detects page edges and corrects perspective, keeps every scan on-device in a private library, and adds no watermark and no sign-up. A one-time Paperlane Pro purchase adds searchable OCR text, PDF merging, JPG/PNG export, password protection, and removes ads.

Point, scan, and get a clean PDF in seconds. No subscription, no watermark, no account.

FREE, FOREVER
• Unlimited scans with automatic edge detection and perspective correction
• Real, multi-page PDFs that open, print and share anywhere
• A tidy on-device library, and your documents never leave your iPhone
• No watermark. No scan limit. No sign-up.
• Supported by ads, which Paperlane Pro removes

PAPERLANE PRO, one-time purchase
• Searchable OCR text layer (find any word inside a scan)
• Combine pages into one PDF
• Export as JPG or PNG
• Password-protect sensitive PDFs
• Removes all ads

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Scanning, text recognition and PDF creation all happen on your device. Your scans are never uploaded to our servers. The free version shows ads served by Google AdMob, which never receive your documents. You are asked for consent first, and can withdraw it at any time under Ad privacy in the settings.

Pay once, keep it forever. No monthly fees, ever.

Where available, you can explore recommendations for our other apps. They load online; views and taps are counted as daily totals without personal profiles or user/device identifiers. Our privacy policy explains this feature and existing advertising.
Privacy Policy: https://getpaperlane.vercel.app/privacy
promotionalText: On-device PDF scanner with automatic edge detection and true multi-page output. Pay once for OCR search: no subscription, no watermark, no account.
whatsNew: Discover more apps from us in the new recommendations section. Updated privacy information.
